text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow ow...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I blew it... I was making sure to check
fortune and discern the flow of ki
while doing it too, though...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, for some reason, the earth's voice feels
a bit harder to hear today... Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, I'm fine, totally fine!
I can't spread the wonders of feng shui if I let something like this get to me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's patch this up real quick
and get back to training!
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't make such a serious face,
Trainer~! I'm fine, really, so
let's get right to training...
choice_data_list: Getting in peak physical condition is also part of Feng Shui, right?
Getting in peak physical condition is also part of Feng Shui, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah, you're right. Ahaha, sorry,
I guess I wasn't really keeping my cool.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe my vision was just clouded.
Is that why I couldn't hear the voice of the earth...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's enough training for today.
I'll get proper rest and focus on healing up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her demeanor remained gentle, she was clearly feeling down.
It seemed it would take some time for Copano Rickey to get back into top form...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! As long as we keep fortune and misfortune in mind,
we'll be totally fine☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Taking into account today's auspicious direction, elemental compatibility, and lucky color, the gymnasium is totally the ☆lucky spot☆!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so, we're resuming training right away!
Targeted strength training shouldn't affect the injury, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Huff, huff, ...khh!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
M-Maybe it really is tough, after all...?
But if I want to spread feng shui further,
I have to do my best...
choice_data_list: Let's focus on your treatment after all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, definitely...
If we use feng shui to properly boost your health luck,
you'll heal up from any injury in no time, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I really will get proper rest
and do my best to get better quickly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite those encouraging words, she still seemed downhearted... and her injury ended up taking longer to heal.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, looking good! Moving to the gym
was definitely the right call after all!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, today I'll focus on muscle training here to build up my fundamentals!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps thanks to the positive mindset brought by feng shui, Copano Rickey was able to cheerfully work on strength training that wouldn't agitate her injury.
